job.job_description:
Service Line
Information Systems
Educational Requirements
Bachelor of Engineering
Responsibilities
Develop and deploy Generative AI solutions using LLMs and AI frameworks.
Build AI-powered applications, chatbots, and automation solutions.
Design and implement prompts, RAG pipelines, and AI workflows.
Integrate AI models with enterprise applications and APIs.
Fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize model performance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements.
Perform testing, debugging, and monitoring of AI applications.
Stay updated with emerging trends in Generative AI and Machine Learning.
Additional Responsibilities
Exposure to RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures.
Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Basic understanding of MLOps and model deployment.
Experience with Git and Agile methodologies.
Technical and Professional Requirements
1-2 years of experience in Python development.
Knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Prompt Engineering.
Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar.
Understanding of Machine Learning and NLP concepts.
Familiarity with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, or other AI platforms.
Experience with REST APIs and application integration.
Knowledge of vector databases such as Pinecone, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Technology->AI-Data science->Machine Learning
Technology->AI-Generative AI->Conversational AI Platform
Technology->AI-Generative AI->Generative AI - Basic->model framework (langchain)
Technology->AI-Generative AI->Generative AI for Data Analytics
